task.summary: Default task

Refactor user and loan calculator classes to streamline initialization and improve loan logic. Introduce consulta classes for book and user inquiries, enhancing system usability. But, there are some logic in the notifications that needs change -> We actually can´t see if the "exemplares" were "devolvidos" or not. And, we need to create something related to getDataReservas(). Some bugs were corrected too
